description: Coinbase Exchange trading products (pairs) with status and minimum order sizes, filtered by quote currency (default USD). Lists what can be traded; no prices. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_coinbase_candles when you need Coinbase Exchange OHLCV candles for one product at 1m, 5m; crypto_coinbase_assets when you need currency list from Coinbase's public v2 API: currency code. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

quote.description: Quote currency, e.g. USD, EUR, BTC (default USD)
